notes: Exact printed disc serial was not independently read.
Remastered soundtrack; 21 tracks.
More than 100 illustrations.
Trader Games directly identifies the box languages as French/Dutch and manual as French.
The exact Limited product is independently corroborated by VGCollect, Fnac France and bol Netherlands.
Exact printed disc serial was not independently read.
Trader Games directly identifies EAN 3499550355635 as the Europe United Kingdom edition with English box/manual.
Software languages for this exact UK physical disc were not independently documented and remain unresolved.
World of Games and reBuy identify Blu-ray media; exact printed disc serial was not independently read.
Germany-specific sources conflict on 2017-03-10 versus 2017-03-17; no date is selected in the structured release.
World of Games explicitly identifies German packaging; software languages are from its product metadata.
No Germany-specific physical CUSA/product-code evidence was independently tied to EAN 3499550355642; CUSA-04802 is therefore not assigned to this SKU in the structured identifiers.
An age-18 classification is shown in German retail metadata, but the exact printed rating-system label was not independently read, so ratingSystem remains unresolved.
Exact printed disc serial was not independently read.
M3 Elettronica directly corroborates the exact PS4 Limited Edition reference/EAN 3499550355659.
CUSA-04802, English/Italian packaging, PEGI 18 and 2017-03-17 appeared only in search-result or technical metadata during this research and therefore remain unresolved for the exact Italian SKU.
Software-language metadata was not independently read from the Italian physical disc.
A direct eBay Spain product listing ties EAN 3499550355666 and CUSA-04802 to the Spanish PS4 Limited Edition and explicitly identifies it as Edición Española.

Fnac Portugal shows the same EAN circulating in Portugal, but retailer location alone does not establish a separate Portuguese package; Spain remains the only confirmed distribution market for this SKU in this result.
Spain-specific packaging languages, software languages, exact release date and factory contents were not confirmed from an opened Spain-specific physical source.
The physical package is confirmed; exact disc count and printed disc serial were not independently documented in this run.
Primary Japanese announcement states the packaged PS4 version, release date, one-player classification and that Intergrow licensed/published it in Japan.
Rakuten Books and Kaitori World independently link JAN 4571331332291 with PLJM-80265.
The Japanese PlayStation Store CUSA07833 page describes the digital title family and is not used as the physical product code.

Only one specialist release database located an Australian Limited Edition dated 2017-03-24 with MA classification; no independent exact product identifier, package-language evidence or second physical-product source was obtained.
Limited contents are the documented edition contents generally, but were not independently read from an Australian package.

unresolved.reason: No readable Spain-specific back-cover/package-language evidence was obtained. Software languages are kept separate and come from the official European CUSA04802 title family.
Japanese physical identity is confirmed, but exact printed package languages and physical-disc software languages were not independently documented.
No exact printed game-disc serial was independently read for the documented European Limited SKUs; CUSA values are retained only where product-level evidence ties them to the SKU.
Exact German EAN 3499550355642 is confirmed, but no Germany-specific physical CUSA/product code or exact printed rating-system label was independently tied to that EAN.
Fnac Portugal shows commercial circulation of EAN 3499550355666, but retailer location alone does not prove a distinct Portuguese package or dedicated Portugal distribution market.
Only one specialist database documents the Australian Limited release/date/rating; barcode, product code, package languages and independent physical corroboration remain unresolved.
Candidate Limited Edition identifiers surfaced in aggregator/search evidence but lack two-source market/edition/component corroboration and are not modeled as releases.
Trader Games states that additional DLC is no longer available, but the exact original entitlement or code content was not defined sufficiently to model a factory-included download.

Front/back image searches were attempted for every documented release. Exact attributable front URLs were retained only for the UK and Italy releases; no trustworthy exact regional front/back pair was found for the remaining releases.

The strict requirement of two currently active, independent, exact-region/edition comparable secondhand listings was not met for any release/state. Individual observations are retained only as context where appropriate and every proposedBasePrice remains null.
The packaged PS4 release and PLJM/JAN identifiers are confirmed, but exact disc count and printed disc serial were not independently documented.
Germany-specific sources conflict: World of Games reports 2017-03-10 while reBuy reports 2017-03-17. The structured Germany release date is left null.
